notes: Original, synthetic, hand-authored small-case evaluation. The corpus and query labels were frozen before running retrieval. The embedding model is not trained on this archive, and these queries are not an external or blinded benchmark. Do not tune thresholds on these cases and call the resulting result held-out. Similarity scores are not probabilities. In-domain unanswerable questions intentionally test whether related retrieval is mistaken for factual support.
